fit.sheet: onsemi MPSA05/MPSA06/MPSA55/MPSA56 data sheet, Rev. 2 (January 2006, MPSA05/D)
fit.figure: Figure 10. MPSA05/06 DC Current Gain (25 °C, VCE = 1.0 V); Figure 12. MPSA05/06 "ON" Voltages: VBE(on) at VCE = 1.0 V (25 °C); Figure 12 (VCE(sat) at IC/IB = 10, 25 °C); Figure 4. MPSA05/06 Capacitance (Cibo, 25 °C); Figure 4 (Cobo); Figure 2 (MPSA05/06 Current-Gain-Bandwidth Product, VCE = 2.0 V): 197 MHz at 10 mA, the table's condition (100 MHz minimum); VCB = 2 V less VBE(on) 0.64 V read from Figure 12 at 10 mA
fit.method: Gummel-Poon (scripts/fit_models.py). IS, NF, BF, ISE, NE, IKF, NKF and RE by least squares on the hFE and VBE(on) curves at VCE = 1 V together (points: the curves read at 1-2-5 steps); no Early voltage (VAF left out): the sheet gives no output admittance or output curves, so none is set (ngspice's default). BR, ISC, NC and RC by least squares on the VCE(sat) curve, the hFE points held, NR = NF, at IC/IB = 10. CJE, VJE, MJE from Cibo and CJC, VJC, MJC from Cobo against reverse voltage. TF from fT 196.9 MHz at 10.08 mA (Figure 2 (MPSA05/06 Current-Gain-Bandwidth Product, VCE = 2.0 V): 197 MHz at 10 mA, the table's condition (100 MHz minimum); VCB = 2 V less VBE(on) 0.64 V read from Figure 12 at 10 mA), less the junctions' charging time. Fitted curves are matched within 3.0 % (hFE), 6.3 mV (VBE) and 4.6 mV (VCE(sat)). RB, VAR, TR and the temperature terms are ngspice's defaults: the sheet doesn't pin them
fit.note: The MPSA05 and MPSA06 share the sheet's figures and its gain, saturation and VBE(on) limits; the MPSA06 differs in its 80 V ratings. The table gives hFE minimums only (100 at 10 and 100 mA), no range, so the typical 25 °C curve is used as drawn. The fit grid is the 1-2-5 steps plus the curves' ends (0.52 and 490 mA), because the curves start at 0.5 mA
